emergency-dentistry.description: Emergency dentist in McLean and Alexandria, VA for toothaches, abscesses and broken or knocked-out teeth. Same-day space made wherever possible.

mentions.name: A knocked-out tooth
mentions.description: Act now. This one is time-critical. Put the tooth back in its socket and hold it there. If you cannot, place it in a small container of milk . Do not scrub it clean. Replaced in time and splinted, it may be saveable. The same applies to a partially dislodged tooth.

mentions.name: A toothache that will not go away
mentions.description: Persistent pain generally means infection, often inside the tooth. Sometimes a filling is the whole answer. Sharp pain on biting points to the root, and those cases usually need root canal therapy.

mentions.name: A broken tooth
mentions.description: Minor chips can wait for a normal appointment. A tooth fractured after trauma cannot, because the damage may run past the surface. A filling, a crown or a root canal, depending on the break; the most severe need an emergency extraction.

mentions.name: An abscess
mentions.description: An infection from an injury, a cavity or previous dental work can form an abscess at the base of the tooth root. Treatment frequently means an emergency root canal to clear the damaged pulp out of the root.

mentions.name: Dry socket, after an extraction
mentions.description: If the pain after an extraction has become intense, the clot in the socket may have been dislodged, exposing bone and nerve. Treat it immediately: the socket is cleaned and packed with gauze.

dental-conditions.name: Dental Conditions We Treat | McLean & Alexandria, VA
dental-conditions.description: Loose dentures, bleeding gums, cracked teeth, toothache and more: what each usually means and how Dr. Nahlah treats it in McLean and Alexandria, VA.

about.name: Loose Dentures
about.description: Jawbone recession lets a denture come loose, and a loose denture rubs. The fix is anchorage: implant-supported dentures or full-arch implants, fixed into the jaw and strong enough to eat normally with. Fixed vs. removable

about.name: Bad Breath
about.description: Occasional is normal. Constant bad breath, alongside gums that bleed and teeth that loosen, is gum disease, and untreated it aggravates diabetes, high blood pressure and cardiovascular disease. Treated with customized gum disease therapy.

about.name: Bleeding Gums
about.description: The earliest sign of gum disease. Tartar releases bacteria, the gums redden, swell and recede, and advanced gum disease eventually stops being curable. Surgical and non-surgical treatments both exist; an evaluation settles which.

about.name: Cracked Teeth
about.description: Once a tooth is broken open, bacteria get inside and the infection can end in root canal therapy. Treated with a filling, bonding, an inlay, an onlay or a crown, depending on how much tooth is left. Crowns & bridges

about.name: Crooked Teeth
about.description: Not only cosmetic. Misaligned teeth hold plaque where a brush cannot reach, and they skew the bite, which shows up as jaw discomfort rather than as an aesthetic complaint.

about.name: Gum Disease
about.description: Red, receding or tender gums, and pockets forming between gum and tooth. Untreated it leads to tooth loss and jawbone recession, and is linked to respiratory disease, diabetes, pregnancy complications, heart disease, stroke and cancer.

about.name: A Gummy Smile
about.description: Gums frame the teeth, and the proportion between the two is most of what makes a smile look right. Precise recontouring rebalances the gumline, usually in a single visit.

about.name: Missing or Failing Teeth
about.description: Without a root stimulating it, the bone under the empty socket deteriorates, and it spreads, which is how one lost tooth becomes the neighboring ones. Bridges and implants both restore the smile; only implants protect the jaw. Dental implants

about.name: Toothache
about.description: The tooth is X-rayed, so what is happening inside the enamel is visible rather than guessed at, and the aim is always to keep the natural tooth. Wisdom teeth aside, an extracted tooth should be replaced. If it is urgent

about.name: Yellow or Discolored Teeth
about.description: A full set of healthy teeth can still be a smile someone hides. Professional whitening handles it, and the shade is chosen with you rather than set once. Teeth whitening
